# Tabler Icons Webfont

Tabler Icons Webfont 3.35.0. The stylesheet and WOFF2 font are vendored locally so site icons do not depend on a runtime jsDelivr request. Preserve the license in [`LICENSE`](./LICENSE).

Upstream project: https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons
Upstream package: `@tabler/icons-webfont@3.35.0`
